fishing: WHEN: Saturday evening Oct 3. Solunar major still 6:53–8:53p (moon-down) after the morning major 6:19–8:19a that lined up with sunrise 7:23a and a Lemon Bay high ~6:24a. Afternoon low ~2:38p; coefficient 41, light current. SE 5–10 kt, light chop, storms lingering into the evening — fish the pass and trough edges before the cells, then the evening major if it clears. Snook harvest open in Charlotte Harbor / SW through Nov 30 (slot 28–33, 1/day). PASSES-BEACH: Fishin Franks 10/2 has redfish and snook on shoreline edges of the trough; ladyfish, bluefish and trout mixed in, not a hot surf day. Stump Pass islands still the earlier hold; Spanish were just outside the pass. Manasota first light remains the snook window. LEMON BAY: 10/2 docks and mangroves holding mangrove snapper, small black drum, redfish and a few snook; trout on the grass. NEARSHORE: fall mix — mangrove snapper inside 20 miles, permit and cobia on wrecks, Spanish around bait (Waterline / Economy Tackle mid-Sep; Franks 10/2 west-wall reds strong after the weak front). Baits: live shrimp, cut bait, pinfish, white bait, gold spoons, topwater.
redtide: FWC Oct 2: K. brevis background only in SWFL (three Sarasota samples); not observed in Charlotte, including Englewood Beach 6.4 mi W and Stump Pass. No fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 9.
bacteria: Manasota Key Beach GOOD, no advisory — enterococci 10 on 9/28 (Healthy Beaches, updated 10/3). Englewood Beach GOOD, last listed 20 CFU, no advisory.
fpl: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota 149 customers out this evening; no Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
